metadata.description: Teach AI coding tools to design, edit, and validate pencil.dev UIs through the Pencil MCP server.

plugins.name: pencil-dev-skill
plugins.description: Use this skill for any pencil.dev work: designing UI in a .pen file, editing an open Pencil canvas, instantiating components from a .lib.pen library, fixing batch_design schema errors, or recovering from Pencil MCP host-not-connected issues. Routes every read and write through the Pencil MCP server for schema validation, live screenshots, and editor sync.
